title: Meet the Club's AI Agent Roster
placeholder: Click any agent to see the club task it handles and an example.

nodes.label: Leveraging AI Agents
detail: Matching a task to the agent type built for it, rather than one tool trying to do everything.

nodes.label: Planning Agent
detail: Drafts a sequence of dates or steps toward a goal, respecting stated constraints.

nodes.label: Communication Agent
detail: Drafts a reply or announcement pulling from the club's own policies.

nodes.label: Registration Agent
detail: Processes new sign-ups against the club's ratio cap and waitlist rules.
Moving a family off the waitlist.

nodes.label: Scheduling Agent
detail: Cross-references mentor availability against venue hours.
Proposing which of three dates has full mentor coverage.

nodes.label: Reminder Agent
detail: Drafts a reminder tailored to the specific family and moment, beyond a fixed timer.
Mentioning a badge a student is one session from finishing.

nodes.label: Mentor Coaching Agent
detail: Drafts coaching suggestions from aggregated, anonymized patterns -- never from one identified student's record.
Flagging a badge that has become a bottleneck for a whole cohort.
